current_function_destination: Treasury, a division of the County Clerk
notes: H.J.R. 134 and Article XVI, Section 44(d) abolish the Galveston County Treasurer office effective January 1, 2024. The county publishes treasury functions as a division of the County Clerk. A staff-directory department tag that still associates Commissioner Hank Dugie with the Treasurer's Office is treated as stale historical metadata, not a vacancy, incumbent, or current elected office.
